Phase 1 · Team One

Analyze your three assigned clients

Use the provided scenario facts and clearly labeled assumptions to build each IPS mandate.

Use the slides and data together

Start with your team's client slides. They state the case background, goal, and main constraint. Match each client to the row in the scenario-data workbook for the provided target return, standard deviation, and risk classification. Treat these as case inputs to evaluate, not automatic promises or approved limits.

When an IPS field is missing, use a reasonable assumption supported by a scenario clue and label it Assumption. If no defensible basis exists for a specific value, write Not provided; confirm before implementation. Do not turn an inference into a supplied client fact.

Activity sequence

Work from the case evidence

1

Read the assigned files

Use only your team's three client profiles and the matching client-data rows. Record stated goals, numerical case inputs, constraints, and source locations.

2

Draft a human-first view

Each of the five roles records a provisional judgment for each client before AI use, naming the supplied fact or clearly labeled assumption behind it.

3

Resolve missing fields

For each IPS field not specified, make a plausible case-based assumption with a reason or mark the information as not provided. Never present an assumption as a client statement.

4

Challenge and verify

Test the first interpretation as a committee, verify material claims against the case files or approved sources, and record alternatives and trade-offs.

5

Finish the mandate

Use the submitted macro outlook, three scenario analyses, and documented assumptions to complete the IPS mandates and prepare for Gate 1.

Before writing the IPS

Document, challenge, and hand off

  • Mark every material statement as a supplied fact, a reasoned assumption, or an information gap.
  • Explain the scenario clue behind each assumption and what later confirmation could change.
  • Set a provisional client guardrail that later security selection or allocation must honor.
  • Record the reasoning and an independent peer review in the Analyst Decision Log.

Return when ready

Convert scenario analysis into the client mandate

Use the three case analyses and your submitted macro outlook to complete the Phase 1 IPS mandates.
